effect.name: Dither
effect.description: Ordered (Bayer) dithering with an adjustable number of levels. Where Posterize bands, this one trades banding for a woven pattern, the way an artist fakes a gradient with two colours.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Levels
parameter.description: Steps per channel after dithering. 2 is one bit per channel.

parameter.name: Dither Strength
parameter.description: 0 quantises with hard bands, 1 dithers fully.

parameter.name: Pattern Scale
parameter.description: Size of one dither cell in texels. Raise it if the game is drawn small and scaled up.

parameter.name: Coarse Pattern
parameter.description: On uses a 2x2 matrix, off uses 4x4.

parameter.name: Luminance Only
parameter.description: On dithers brightness and keeps the hue smooth. Off dithers each channel, which is what a real indexed palette does.
